# Noobot v4.4.5

Changes since v4.4.4:

- Unify model contracts, recovery diagnostics, usage metrics, and execution reports.
- Strengthen file transactions, encoding preservation, resource access, and WebSocket authentication.
- Improve chat navigation, file and image previews, shared controls, and desktop startup reliability.
- Refine task summaries, configurable tool bindings, and MCP lifecycle management, with broader regression and audit coverage.
